generator_inputs: Previously recorded public commands, explicit public configuration, operation-bound approved target outputs and synthetic role-scoped signing service. No database projection or observed response is passed into generation.
diagnostic_inputs: Real SQLite connection and independently advanced model state, only after generating and comparing that event. The diagnostic is not the simulator.

R1: challenge ownership, expiry, use and audience
credential identity/digest and no scoped tombstones in this fixture
R2: successful real L1 calls and model operation/kind/tick
R4: outbox identity/descriptor and route high watermark

private_fields: No snapshot rows, private work accumulators, seed bytes or result bytes are returned to the checker. SQL computes seed/result non-null presence bits. Encrypted transport evidence and private data are not needed for these R1-R4 projections.
state_digest: Deterministic tagged JSON normalization of selected equal projections, hashed separately by relation. Digests document checkpoints; they are not a substitute for rerunning real database checks.
randomness_scope: Valid finite tapes conditioned on a prescribed output; eight data masks per public plan. Not an exhaustive distribution experiment.
limitations: The selected projections are not a complete model of every SQLite field or every runtime invariant.
Shared model transitions and public codecs remain; implementation independence is incomplete.
Static synthetic setup with at most two successful operations, existing finite plans, and no route or credential administration events.
Additional expiry tests change trusted fixture enrollment before requests, never mutate enrolled keys as a supported protocol action.
No transaction-internal crash points, recovery/retirement events, witness history, physical time, storage traffic or resource exhaustion are checked here.
Complete real storage relations for R5-R8 and general induction over allowed adversaries remain open.
